latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Data Labeling Studio.

- Supports intelligent data labeling and annotation for images, text, audio, and video
- Includes active learning suggestions and quality control checks
- Multiple annotation formats supported: COCO, YOLO, Pascal VOC, TFRecord, HuggingFace, and more
- Tools provided for annotation, quality checking, and dataset export
- Example usage and script files included for all major features
